The two maps below show a small town called Lakeside in 1990 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

1990: The town centre had a market square, surrounded by small shops and a church. There was a primary school to the north, farmland to the east, and a lake with a forest to the south. A single main road connected the town to the highway.

2020: The market square has been replaced by a shopping mall. The farmland to the east has been developed into a residential housing estate. A new secondary school and sports centre have been built to the north. The forest to the south has been partially cleared for a car park and hotel. A new ring road now circles the town, and a railway station has been built to the west.
